svg.title: When a ready-made curriculum can be added
svg.desc: When the page opens, the app looks at the school. If a curriculum was added before, it shows what was created. If there is an academic year, class, subject, student, exam, grading scale or exam structure, one cannot be added. In a brand-new school, choose a curriculum, set the options and type the name to confirm, and everything is created at once. You cannot undo it yourself; only a platform administrator can undo it, and only while the school has no working data.
